title: Fix dev Taiwan chip refresh lease-guard loop and 300s bounded controller RPC timeout
delivery_scope: Source-only: wrap all 6 Taiwan chip refresh profiles under a single run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh invocation with SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300; forward SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS across SSH and local refresh-only execution and preserve caller-supplied SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS in execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint and manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime; raise validate_source_refresh_profile controller RPC timeout cap from 120s to 300s; add regression tests.
changes: In .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml step Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh, set SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: 300 and invoke .lease-controller/scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh once wrapping a bash -c script that iterates all 6 chip profiles and exits with failed at the end so one failing profile does not stop the shared lease heartbeat before remaining profiles run.

In scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh, forward SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS in ssh_bash refresh-only command_prefix and in run_remote_payload local refresh-only environment.

In scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh, preserve caller-supplied SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS (defaulting to 100 within the 1..500 guard) in execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint and manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime bounded action.
In scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh validate_source_refresh_profile, raise the SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS cap from 120 seconds to 300 seconds.

Updated scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py and added regression tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py verifying single-lease-guard chip execution, SSH/local refresh-only env forwarding, caller-supplied SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS preservation, and the 300s controller timeout cap.

acceptance_status.1: met: .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml Execute bounded Taiwan chip refresh wraps all six chip refresh profiles inside a single .lease-controller/scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh invocation and sets SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to 300
acceptance_status.2: met: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh forwards SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS across SSH and local refresh-only invocations and preserves caller-supplied SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS (defaulting to 100 within the existing 1..500 guard) in execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint and manage_source_ingest_refresh_runtime
acceptance_status.3: met: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh validate_source_refresh_profile caps SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS at 300 seconds instead of 120 seconds
acceptance_status.4: met: regression tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py and scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh_workflow.py verify single-lease-guard chip execution, SSH/local env forwarding, and the 300s controller timeout cap; evidence.json records commands and pass counts with hosted_behavior_claimed false
